entries.name: Ocean
entries.content:

In the mainland of continents, most mamono seen are usually in rivers, marshlands, lakes, and swamps. This is the habitat for Bunyips, Kappa (Zipangu) Undines, Kelpies, Sahagins, Mucus Toads 
Apsara, Mantango, Vamp Mosquito, and Giant Slugs, who are capable of movement on land, but reside in the water as their habitat. 

Within the ocean are where most of the aquatic mamono reside, such as Sea Bishops, Mermaids, Otohimes (Zipangu), Merrows, Mersharks, Nerenids, Charybidis, Cancers, Krakens, Sea Slimes, and Scyllas.
